import numpy as np, collections
for nm in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    I=np.array(G[nm+' input']); O=np.array(G[nm+' output'])
    H,W=I.shape
    print('==',nm)
    for comp in comps_zero(I):
        vals={int(I[r+dr][c+dc]) for r,c in comp for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
              if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and I[r+dr][c+dc]!=0}
        touch=any(r==0 or r==H-1 or c==0 or c==W-1 for r,c in comp)
        # neighbors outside? none. also check diagonal touches of border? no.
        filled=len([1 for r,c in comp if (r,c) in {(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]}])

                                 if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and I[r+dr][c+dc]!=0)
        pred = list(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]) if not touch else []
        actual = {int(O[r][c]) for r,c in comp if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]}
        print(f" size{len(comp):3d} bbox{(min(r for r,_ in comp),max(r for r,_ in comp),min(c for _,c in comp),max(c for _,c in comp))} "
              f"touchborder={touch} nbsingle={len(vals)==1 and len({v for v in vals})==1} vals={vals} "
              f"filled={filled}/{len(comp)} predicted={pred} actualfilled={actual}")
